title: Avengers: Endgame Has MORE Doomsday Easter Eggs?! 🥚😱 #russobrothers

author: CBR
description:
Avengers: Doomsday has hidden connections to Avengers: Endgame, and Joe and Anthony Russo are teasing what fans may have missed.
The Russo Brothers revisit their MCU blockbuster and reveal that Endgame contains additional clues pointing toward Doomsday. They discuss Thor's upcoming journey, why they prefer his warrior persona from Infinity War, and the emotional storytelling behind Tony Stark's final sacrifice.
The directors also reflect on Captain Marvel's pivotal role, Steve Rogers' journey, and how the Marvel Cinematic Universe connects seemingly separate stories. From the meaning of "I love you 3000" to the future of Thor, the Russos offer a fascinating look at Marvel's past and future.
